payout_quote: Get $150 as a statement credit after your first purchase. When you open an account and make a purchase in the first 90 days. Limited-time offer.
steps: Be a Verizon wireless Account Owner or Account Manager (up to 12 lines) or an active Fios Account Owner
Apply and be approved for the Verizon Visa Signature Card (issued by Synchrony, $0 annual fee)
Make your first purchase within 90 days of account opening
$150 statement credit posts after the first purchase
catches: Must already be a Verizon wireless or Fios customer to apply - not open to the general public
Limited-time offer; Verizon can alter or discontinue the offer at any time
Statement credit cannot be used to satisfy the required monthly payment and is not redeemable for cash
Credit approval required; application triggers a hard inquiry
Never spend extra just to chase the bonus - any purchase you would not have made anyway costs you
Annual-fee net math: $0 annual fee, so the $150 is net of fees as long as you pay in full
Balance-carrying/APR risk: variable APR ~22.99%-33.99% wipes the $150 value quickly if you carry a balance - pay the statement balance in full
biggest_catch: Only Verizon wireless/Fios customers can apply at all - and the credit is store credit toward Verizon, never cash.
eligibility: Verizon wireless Account Owner/Manager (up to 12 lines) or Fios Account Owner with active service; approved for the Verizon Visa Signature Card
timing: Credit posts after the first qualifying purchase (older tiered version credited 1-2 billing cycles after purchase); must make first purchase within 90 days of account opening.
